articles.title: Source: Elastic agrees to buy CRV-backed DeductiveAI for up to $85M
articles.summary: DeductiveAI, a startup that uses AI to catch and resolve bugs in software, was founded just three years ago.
articles.author: Marina Temkin

articles.title: AI inference startup Baseten reportedly raising $1.5B months after its last mega-round
articles.summary: Startup Baseten is reportedly close to finalizing a $1.5 billion round at a $13 billion as the “inference gold rush" marches on.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: Snap spins off AI video team into new company, Dotmo, due to costs
articles.summary: The Snapchat maker is spinning off yet another internal unit. Dotmo will be composed of current Snap staff who are leaving the social media company to focus on AI video development.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: OpenAI is bringing on some big guns in the lead-up to its IPO
articles.summary: OpenAI is bulking up before its IPO, landing Transformer co-inventor Noam Shazeer from Google DeepMind and former Trump AI policy official Dean Ball in the same week.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: The 11 standout startups from YC’s Demo Day, according to VCs
articles.summary: TechCrunch spoke to investors to find the hottest startups in the Spring 2026 YC batch. Some of them commanded valuations of over $175 million, VCs said.
articles.author: Marina Temkin, Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: Almost half of US singles feel negatively about AI in dating, Match says
articles.summary: About 47% of singles look negatively at the use of AI in dating -- but many dating app users are open to AI helping with profile punch-ups and conversation starters.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Amazon hopes to challenge Nvidia more directly by selling its AI chips
articles.summary: AWS is in talks to sell its chips to other data centers. CEO Andy Jassy has said this represents a $50 billion opportunity for the company.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: AI data centers just got a government-mandated fast lane to the grid
articles.summary: FERC told grid operators to give data centers a fast lane for interconnections, but it failed to address electricity supply shortages.
articles.author: Tim De Chant

articles.title: ‘Queer Eye’ life coach Karamo Brown launches Kē, a wellness app featuring his AI digital clone
articles.summary: After spending a year and a half focusing on his own journey — from fitness and nutrition to meditation, sobriety, relationships, and personal growth — Brown wants to help others do the same.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal

articles.title: General Intuition in talks to raise $300M at around $2B valuation
articles.summary: The startup trains embodied AI and world models using Medal’s dataset of 2 billion videos per year from 10 million monthly active users.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: A tech worker-backed PAC is bringing a $5M knife to Big Tech’s $100M gunfight
articles.summary: Guardrails positions itself as a populist political movement that runs on small donations from people in the trenches of the AI boom.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan
